description: Value of Freight Transport and Logistics Sector is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset provides modelled outputs of GVA and employment in NSW, including in-house, for-hire, and upstream types. Data are in the format of csv. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Freight, NSW Freight. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
